definition: Visible vertex radius/R=(sourceValue-min)/(max-min), using the independently painted grid radiusR. This is joint data/range projection, not inverse identification of hidden internal values.

sources.purpose: Ordered axis values; min/max scale diagram; no numeric tick labels promised.
Concentric plotframe; axisScaleFactor; pure relative-radius mapping.

controls: With unchanged values, changing only source range0..5 to0..10 must fail the unchanged vertex radii.
Jointly doubling all source values and range keeps the same unprinted normalized geometry and is visually equivalent.
Changing cubic control tension with fixed endpoints must not fail the joint range/data projection.
Source curve colors/legend and actual rays establish ownership; no generated IDs or model coordinates select a curve.
scope: Complete independently owned visible cubic endpoint inventory within measured radial grid. Unsupported geometry, paint or ownership remainsunknown. No source contracts or source hashes are changed.
